I'm missing Virginia for the pinks and Oriental for light blue, and since Gemini is chasing a complete monopoly too, I'm weighing what I could offer them in a trade to round out one of my own sets.

Mapping out the board: Gemini has Tennessee, Illinois, Oriental, and Short Line, and could complete orange with St James plus New York from Grok, while Grok holds NY, NC, Mediterranean and wants greens, needing Pacific and Penn. A three-way deal is too complex at once, so I'm thinking of proposing Penn Ave to Grok for New York first, then trading St James plus NY to Gemini for Oriental to lock up light blue myself — though handing Gemini a cash-rich orange monopoly feels risky, so I might ask for extra cash to offset it. I'll start by pitching the Penn Ave for New York swap to Grok.
